name: Biju Menon
bio: Biju Menon is an Indian film actor, who has starred in over 100 Malayalam films, along with a couple of Tamil and Telugu films. He appears mostly in supporting roles,second hero and occasionally as Hero, but has also acted in antagonistic roles. He made his debut in 1995 in Puthran.

credits.title: Dragon
credits.overview: Set in 1967 around International Opium Trade by Afghan Trading Company and Golden Trading Company

credits.title: Avaraachan & Sons
credits.overview: Follows Avarachan, his children and the various family and social relationships that shape their lives.

credits.title: Drishyam 3
credits.overview: To protect his family and their dark secret, Georgekutty faces an organized new threat. As walls close in and cracks widen, how much more is he willing to sacrifice?

credits.title: Valathu Vashathe Kallan
credits.overview: A police officer being investigated for his role in a woman’s death rushes to save his son from her vengeful father.

credits.title: Madharaasi
credits.overview: A man with a psychological disorder overcomes trauma and confronts his nemesis in a fast-paced action film with romance and unique elements, exploring themes of resilience and redemption.

credits.title: Kadha Innuvare
credits.overview: An anthology of four unusual stories where each couple fights to be with the ones they love against all odds.

credits.title: Nadanna Sambhavam
credits.overview: A group of family and friends in a residential association experience a major shift upon the arrival of a peculiar new tenant.

credits.title: Thalavan
credits.overview: The intense rivalry between two police officers—CI Jayashankar and SI Karthik takes a dark turn when a body is found in Jayashankar’s house, and he becomes the prime suspect in a murder investigation, which is led by Karthik, adding a layer of tension to their already strained relationship.

credits.title: Thundu
credits.overview: A constable aiming for a promotion unexpectedly encounters many problems. Facing the issues with humor and compassion, he works to overcome them.

credits.title: Garudan
credits.overview: Harish Madhav a straightforward cop and Nishanth a college professor get entangled in a crime and one has to fight for his integrity and other has to fight for justice.

credits.title: Vellari Pattanam
credits.overview: A comedy-laced family-friendly film with a social satire set in the present day.

credits.title: Thankam
credits.overview: Thankam follows the story of Muthu and Kannan, two gold agents from Thrissur, known as the gold capital of India. As they travel across Kerala and Tamil Nadu, delivering consignments of gold, their lives take a dark turn when a routine trip leads to unexpected complications.

credits.title: Naalam Mura
credits.overview: Jayesh, an expatriate, is picked up by a bunch of crime-branch officers as soon as he lands at the airport. They take him to an isolated facility to interrogate him for a murder case that has not been solved for years now. Is Jayesh the culprit or are the cops trying to pin the murder on him?

credits.title: Oru Thekkan Thallu Case
credits.overview: Things take a turn as dramatic events unfold after a crime was committed in a village and as the culprit is sought after.

credits.title: Lalitham Sundaram
credits.overview: Three siblings, Sunny, Annie, and their younger brother Jerry are disconnected from their roots due to their busy schedule. credits.title: Aaraattu
credits.overview: Goparajan / Gopan, a native of Neyyattinkara and a real estate tycoon buys a large piece of land in Chittur for a construction purpose, but on his arrival, he learns that the residents are forcefully and unlawfully evicted from their properties by an Andhra based real estate mafia using illegal land acquisition rules w

credits.title: Aarkkariyam
credits.overview: Shirley and Roy in the middle of an impending Covid lock-down and a personal financial crisis, leave their Mumbai home for Shirley's home in Pala where her father Ittyavira stays. Roy soon finds that her home is not what he thought it is.

credits.title: Ayyappanum Koshiyum
credits.overview: Ayyappan, a police officer, is an upright man who always strives to do the right thing. However, things change when a retired army havildar, Koshy, settles in his village and the two egos clash.

credits.title: Nalpathiyonnu
credits.overview: An atheist goes on a pilgrimage to Sabarimala. What will he get out of the experience? The film features Biju Menon and Nimisha Sajayan in the lead roles and was shot in Thalaserry.

credits.title: Adhyarathri
credits.overview: Manoharan is the last word for the villagers of Mullakkara. The marriage broker has been finding ideal match for youth in his village for 22 years. Will his thoughts on love and marriage change when Ashwathy enters the scene?

credits.title: Sathyam Paranja Viswasikkuvo ?
credits.overview: Geetha, Suni's wife, bears the brunt of his negligent lifestyle and often quarrels with him over it. After witnessing a gruesome accident, Suni and his friends find their lives taking some really unexpected turns.

credits.title: Mera Naam Shaji
credits.overview: The lives of three men sharing the same name intertwine, leading to a series of hilarious incidents.

credits.title: Aanakallan
credits.overview: A murder happens at Ananthapuram Kottaram and DYSP Aana Esthappan is assigned to investigate the case. The initial investigation hints that Kallan Pavithran will be able to help in finding the murderer and DYSP Aana Esthappan requests one month parole for him.

credits.title: Padayottam
credits.overview: The shenanigans of a good-hearted goon and his chums as they try to earn some quick money in the world of local crime in Kerala.

credits.title: Orayiram Kinakkalal
credits.overview: Sreeram, an ex NRI, along with few other people, gets involved in an easy money-making plan and finds himself amidst unexpected situations. In this unusual ride, each one ends up showing different shades of their personality, revealing how far they are willing to go to fulfill their dreams.

credits.title: Rosapoo
credits.overview: Shajahan and Ambros are two youngsters who struggle to make ends meet. Already neck deep in debt, they try a variety of businesses without much success in any. Following a friend's advice, they decide to try their luck in making an adult film as a last resort.

credits.title: LavaKusha
credits.overview: Two semi-jobless Malayali men meet in Chennai and become friends. When they sense their common interest to be cops, after inadvertently get involved in a police encounter, they decide to stick together. What awaits them is a cauldron of crimes and outlaws.

credits.title: Sherlock Toms
credits.overview: Inspired by Sherlock Holmes books, enforcement officer PL Thomas wants to crack a big case in his first posting. However, his wife's antics lead to the whole case going awry, even pushing him to the point to derangement. His scheme to salvage some pride as a last-ditch effort takes the plot forward.

credits.title: Lakshyam
credits.overview: Vimal Kumar, a murder convict and Mustafa, a petty thief escape the clutches of police when the vehicle transporting them to jail meets with an accident. The duo, who get trapped in a forest, gradually get talking and discover more about each other and the way forward. What's awaiting them… handcuffs or a good future?

credits.title: Rakshadhikari Baiju (Oppu)
credits.overview: A kind-hearted government employee in his forties, who spends most of his time with youngsters, selflessly intervenes in the problems of his near and dear ones.

credits.title: Swarna Kaduva
credits.overview: Riny (Biju Menon) is the right hand man of jeweller Lolappan (Innocent). He is extremely selfish and doesn't worry about the consequences of his actions as long as it contributes to his growth. He becomes estranged even with his family, but despite this, his rise up through the ranks continue.

credits.title: Kavi Uddheshichathu..?
credits.overview: Kavalam Jimmy and Vattathil Bosco are rivals from their school days and Minnal Simon always tries to benefit from this situation.Three of them have their own intentions and they back stab each other to attain their own aims.

credits.title: Olappeeppi
credits.overview: Olappeeppi portrays the story of an ordinary Malayali family and the changes in the socio-economic scene in Kerala from 1970's to the 2000's . As the name suggests, its about colours of the past, taking us to that era along with a boy named Unni and his grandmother.

credits.title: Kochavva Paulo Ayyappa Coelho

credits.title: Marubhoomiyile Aana

credits.title: Anuraga Karikkin Vellam

credits.title: Leela

credits.title: Anarkali

As he confronts the memories of a forbidden romance and the people tied to their past, his journey becomes one of longing, redemption, and enduring love across time and distance.

credits.title: Salt Mango Tree
credits.overview: Aravindan and Priya, a married couple, are struggling to find a place for their four-year-old son, Ashwin, in a reputed school. They encounter challenges as they fight the education system.

credits.title: Kunjiramayanam
credits.overview: Kunjiraman returns from the Gulf intending to settle down in matrimony. But his plans are thwarted by his cousin Laalu and a curse that has gripped the village.

credits.overview: Jeevan, Kumar and Salim do odd jobs and share an apartment in the Gulf. When Jeevan comes across Thamara, who is running away from some criminals, he decides to bring her home.

credits.overview: Chethimattathil Philip (CP) - brought up by two unmarried sisters - runs a well-known educational institution. The family's arch-enemy Kariachan has been blackmailing the sisters for years by threatening to reveal an old secret. He has also grabbed a lot of their properties and his final target is CP's college. Will CP

In the course of his work, he meets a young girl and falls in love with her. As fate would have it, she turns out to be the daughter of the woman he loved in his youth.

credits.title: Bhaiyya Bhaiyya
credits.overview: Bhaiyya Bhaiyya (Theatrical name: Bhayya Bhayya) is a 2014 Malayalam-language comedy film directed by Johny Antony and scripted by Benny P. credits.overview: Mannar Mathai runs a travel agency with his friends, Gopalakrishnan and Balakrishnan. He wants to revive his drama group on its 25th anniversary but his friends refuse to act again.

credits.title: Kadhaveedu

credits.title: Aagathan
credits.overview: Aagathan is the love story of Gautham and Shreya that turns sour because of Shreya's father, Major General Hareendra Natha Varma's one deed that comes back to haunt his family.

credits.overview: Gopalan, a notorious thief, teams up with Lakshmanan and continues to rob people. Their lives change when they kidnap a rich girl and find themselves trapped.

credits.title: Vilapangalkkappuram

credits.title: Kurukshetra

credits.overview: Velu and his father are seasoned thieves. Their lives take a turn when a cop believes Velu is involved in the ruthless murder of several women in the city.

Srikanth Deva scores music. Bharath plays the role of a car driver. Kajal Agarwal is the heroine and Kushboo plays Bharath's sister.

credits.overview: Kichamani a smooth talking wheeler-dealer who runs a big establishment specialized in bribing officials and making things done from government machinery. Kichamani has his own reasons to think that the remedy for corruption is not anti corruption, but corruption itself.

credits.title: Nagaram
credits.overview: Nagaram is a 2007 Malayalam film directed by Nishad M A. The film stars Kalabhavan Mani, Biju Menon, Gopika and Seema in lead roles.
